messages:
Lina: Heads-up: benchmark report + companion webinar scheduled for next Tue. Plan a 3-wave email sequence: teaser, launch (report + register), nurture (record + exec summary). Need owners for segmentation, copy, HubSpot flows, and QA. Quick sync here. :mega:

Raj: I can take segmentation + HubSpot mapping. Proposal for cohorts (behavioral + value):
- alpha_users (highest intent)
- integrations_team (uses API, medium)
- general_newsletter (broad)

Localization windows: NA 11am-1pm PT, EU 9-11am CET, APAC 9-11am SGT. Stagger waves by 36h to hit region peaks.

Priya: I'll draft three subject pipelines and short/long preheaders. Want to run a 3x3 multivariate: subject headline x preheader length x CTA wording. Example subjects to start:
- "New Inference Benchmark: Price & Latency Breakthroughs"
- "How We Cut Token Cost — Benchmark + Live Demo"
- "Webinar: Serving LLMs at Scale (benchmarks inside)"

Connor: For the signup flow, include hidden fields: cohort, source and creative. Use utm params: `?utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_content={{subject_id}}&cohort={{cohort}}`. Also add `referrer=hubspot` on register button.

Bea: HubSpot routing rules: if cohort==alpha_users -> assign `SDR_Priority_High`. If `interested_demo=true` then trigger webhook to `/api/ops/leads` and set lifecycle stage to opportunity. I'll build the workflows after Raj finalizes lists.

Lina: KPIs for first 7 days: alpha open >=30%, CTR >=7% (alpha), webinar signups >=3% (alpha). Bench report downloads >=1.5% overall. Daily snapshot at 9am PT. Dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/reports/bench-launch-2026

Raj: Upload naming convention: `bench_wave{n}_{cohort}_{region}.csv` to gs://marketing-uploads/bench_launch/. Required columns: email, first_name, last_name, cohort, tz, consent. Example CSV:
```
email,first_name,last_name,cohort,tz,consent
alex@example.com,Alex,Ng,alpha_users,PT,true
```

Priya: Copy notes: make APAC subject lines shorter (<=45 chars) and use bullet-style intros in the email body. Also propose a dynamic hero: benchmark stat for alpha_users, product highlight for integrations_team, and social proof for general_newsletter.

Alex: I'll own QA for links, tracking and templates. Will run a test send to staging lists and validate utms + webhook firing. ETA: 24h after templates are ready.

Bea: Retarget logic idea: opens w/o clicks -> send alternate CTA (record + TL;DR). Clicks w/o signup -> send follow-up with demo scheduler. Exports to run nightly 2am PT to s3://exports/bench/retarget_{date}.csv.

Connor: Reminder cadence for registrants: 7d, 2d, 2h. Also include SMS prompt for alpha_users if phone present and consent=true. Needs SMS copy sign-off.

Lina: Approvals: subject + preheaders by EOD Fri, lists uploaded by Raj by Mon 9am PT, templates by Priya by Mon noon. Alex to confirm QA by Mon 6pm PT. Bea to confirm HubSpot flows by Tue morning.

Raj: Uploaded wave1 files to gs://marketing-uploads/bench_launch/wave1_alpha_NA.csv :white_check_mark:

Priya: Draft templates & localization strings: https://docs.google.com/document/d/BenchLaunchCopy — please leave inline comments on tone and CTA.

Alex: QA checklist posted at https://airtable.com/app/bench-qa — I'll tick items as I test. Please add any edge cases.

Bea: I'll create workflows named `bench_launch_flow_v1` and tag contacts `bench_launch_2026`. Also will set lead_score +35 for demo interest.

Lina: One more: throttle general_newsletter to max 1 send per 7 days. For future sequences, add suppression list `recent_contact_30d`.

Connor: Noted re suppression. Also we'll A/B test CTA copy: "Register free" vs "Reserve spot" vs "Watch on demand" for different cohorts.

Lina: Great. Thanks — I'll publish the slack reminder tomorrow with the dashboard link. :tada:
